body.statement: Every jointly realizable continuous-rank primitive vector in \(\mathcal{M}\) satisfies \(A_s\kappa_j/b_{1j}\le5\sqrt{15}/18\), uniformly over active \(j=(C,s)\in J\).
body.justification: This rules out a terminal pure-stage-2 plateau by linking Gaussian coordinates back to feasible finite populations.
body.gap: The bound combines pair-spacing density, variance, and rank covariance and is not present in the Gaussian optimization literature.
body.consumer: Endpoint optimality is certified over actual finite-population limits rather than an enlarged, potentially impossible Gaussian parameter box.
